inputs.text: One of the four inputs into the gate whose output is J: that output is 10V only while all of them are low.
One of the four inputs into the gate whose output is K: that output is 10V only while all of them are low.

outputs.text: 10V while A, B, C and D are all low, 0V as soon as any of them goes high.
10V while E, F, G and H are all low, 0V as soon as any of them goes high.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
